caption: The drawing features three views of a single object, a hand bellows, depicted centrally in full color with front view, and flanked by pencil sketches showing the rear and side views. The central bellows is teardrop-shaped with a narrow handle at the bottom, and a turned, tiered nozzle at the top. The body is primarily yellow with red and black floral or leaf patterns symmetrically arranged on its surface. The handle is yellow with parallel red lines. The upper portion of the bellows, below the nozzle, is brown and appears textured, resembling leather or another flexible material, and is fastened with brass or gold-colored studs. The left pencil sketch is an outline of the bellows in a rear view, showing a simple sunburst-like pattern and the basic shape without ornamentation or color. The right pencil sketch is a side view, indicating the thickness and layered construction of the bellows, as well as the extended nozzle and handle sections, also uncolored. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Fireside Bellows
